ui.review_open_body:
Choose one adventurer to earn Bronze: that person needs {trial_xp} XP, {trial_successes} successes and a solo Lantern Road Trial pass. In Staff, select them and tap APPROVE BRONZE. Rank and XP belong to each person.

Complete A Bridge Worth Keeping with a Bronze leader and {service_quota} different service jobs. Each service job counts once; daily cellar work earns gold and XP only.

Day {cutoff_day} returns and rewards count before the review. Later returns only count in sandbox. Tap BACK TO HEADQUARTERS to begin.
ui.dossier_body: The licence is signed. This adventurer can now lead a Bronze commission. Return by day {cutoff_day} and complete {service_quota} distinct service jobs for head office.
help.welcome: By day {cutoff_day}: promote one Bronze, complete a Bronze commission and {service_quota} distinct service jobs. Tap Review for details.
help.selection_rooms: Tap Assignments (Rooms > Assignments on a phone), then choose an offer. Tap a person for their career.
help.selection_jobs: Tap a member to select them. Checkmarks mark selection. On a phone tap CHOOSE PARTY first.
help.dispatch_rooms: Tap Assignments to review your selected party and send the expedition.
help.dispatch_jobs: Check readiness and return day, then tap DISPATCH PARTY. Compare class match, fatigue and scouting contributions.
help.time: Tap ADVANCE DAY to advance journeys. People at home recover while others travel.
help.reports: Tap Departure to read every return. Each expedition has its own report and automatic rewards.
help.recovery: Leave tired or injured people at home and tap ADVANCE DAY. Typical fatigue clears in two days.
help.trial: Tap Common room, select the rested candidate and tap PREPARE SOLO TRIAL. Check readiness, then tap DISPATCH PARTY.
help.promotion: Tap Common room, select the passed candidate, then APPROVE BRONZE to promote that person.
lesson.welcome_text: Tap BACK TO HEADQUARTERS. Tap a room to open its work or a person to inspect their career. Review shows the day-{cutoff_day} targets: one Bronze certification, one Bronze commission and {service_quota} distinct service successes.
lesson.selection_text: Tap BACK TO HEADQUARTERS, then Assignments (Rooms > Assignments on a phone). Compare the offer rows and select a commission. On a phone tap CHOOSE PARTY, then tap a member row. Checkmarks mark selection; away or injured staff cannot join.
lesson.dispatch_text: Tap BACK TO HEADQUARTERS, then Assignments (Rooms > Assignments on a phone). Check readiness, fatigue and return day. The commission explains the deadline. On a phone tap CHOOSE PARTY to see contributions and optional scouting. Tap DISPATCH PARTY to commit. On short screens, first tap READINESS & DISPATCH.
lesson.time_text: Tap BACK TO HEADQUARTERS, then ADVANCE DAY. Journeys advance immediately and people at home recover or train. The journey card identifies the next return. Tap its entry to inspect the accepted assignment.
lesson.reports_text: Tap BACK TO HEADQUARTERS, then Departure (under Rooms on a phone). Tap a NEW report to inspect its people, outcome and rewards. Tap ACKNOWLEDGE to return to the list. Rewards are applied once on return, never when reading.
lesson.recovery_text: Tap BACK TO HEADQUARTERS. Resting and injured people appear upstairs in Recovery. Tap a person for their exact fatigue and medical leave. Leave them home and tap ADVANCE DAY. Tap Recovery for the optional infirmary upgrade.
lesson.promotion_text: Tap BACK TO HEADQUARTERS, then Common room (under Rooms on a phone) and the candidate. Earn {trial_xp} XP and {trial_successes} successes, pass the solo trial, then tap APPROVE BRONZE when home. Each person earns their own rank. A Bronze leader unlocks the Bronze commission.
lesson.trial_text: Tap BACK TO HEADQUARTERS, then Common room (under Rooms on a phone), the candidate and PREPARE SOLO TRIAL. This selects that person alone. Rest until fatigue clears, check the blockers in the commission, then tap DISPATCH PARTY. The assessment must be unaided.
